notes.title: Devs play SeaRing - Achievements%
notes.content:
The devs try to get all achievements of SeaRing.

[h3]ABOUT SEARING[/h3]
SeaRing is a 2D indie action-puzzle, putting a devilish twist on its predecessors by flipping the script and making defending the only way to attack. Submerge yourself in a world rich in lore, and be taken on a journey full of colourful and often comical storytelling, as you join the Princess of the Sea in a nostalgic quest to recover her mother’s lost crown, become queen, and restore peace in a world now ruled by fire.

As you leave the Water Kingdom behind to venture into the desert, you’ll meet witty and humorous NPCs, witness astonishing backdrops, and be carried by a soothing soundtrack! Will the Princess conquer her foolish foes OR succumb to the pressure and leave her hopes and dreams to dissipate along with the rest of the desert?

notes.title: New Version of the Demo is out!
notes.content:
Hey camarões!

We wanted to thank you for your support, for having played the demo... with a new version of the demo!

While we are working on the next content, we decided to release a "definitive" version of the demo, with this changelog:


- The Big One: [b]Brazilian Portuguese language[/b] support! 
- [b]Mac M1 support [/b]
- [b]Linux support[/b]
- [b]Steam Achievement fixed[/b] (yea, SOME of you got an achievement they shouldn't have!)
- [b]Another Steam achievement simplified[/b] (yea, some of you DIDN´T get an achievement you should have! Just open the demo and talk to someone, it will give it to you, if you deserve it!)

And of lesser importance:
- Language selection pre initial cutscene
- Hit-boxes during the Boss fight
- Credits
- Cutscene speed
- Bugfixes :D

We are currently looking for a publisher, but right now we are working on the second stage of the Princess's journey: the volcano. We could tell you about the remaining stages... But we suppose you'll have to wait and see them for yourselves hehe!

notes.title: The floodgates are open as SeaRing’s demo launches today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the demo launch of our debut title SeaRing, a 2D indie action-puzzle game, free to download today here on Steam! As we edge closer to SeaRing's full release, join the sea princess' journey and embark on a quest to take back her mother’s missing crown through this gorgeous take on the genre.

[b]About the Demo[/b]
You wake up on a sandy beach after being washed ashore, as you first discover the relentless Realm of Fire. Wander through bizarre villages, meet a plethora of hilarious (and possibly sunburnt) NPCs, and complete puzzling puzzles, as you deal with the suspicious Saladino and his crew of criminalistic crabs who’s mission in life is to permanently put an end to yours. Can you be triumphant against Saladino, King of Bandits, and his good-for-nothing gang, or will your dreams and desires be left to dry up in the desert? 

[b]Player Feedback Form[/b]
Like discussed in our previous blog post, your feedback will be key to the game’s development and success. That’s why we’ve implemented a feedback form within the demo upon its completion. The feedback form is a simple questionnaire, which should take no more than five minutes to complete, asking questions like how did you find SeaRing, any bugs or technical issues that you came across, and a few more. It’s not mandatory, but we’d be forever grateful if you gave your thoughts and opinions on our game -  We want to make the best possible version of SeaRing for everyone, and filling out this form would go a very long way in doing so!

On behalf of all of us at SeaRing Team, we want to give a huge thanks for the support we’ve received over the last few months. The support across our social media channels, and the spike of wishlists, have been incredible to see! The world is our oyster and we’re super excited to see what 2022 will bring us.

Thanks for reading!

Best Fishes, 
The SeaRing Team

notes.title: Announcing our first open demo for SeaRing
notes.content:
You read correctly - Our anticipated debut title SeaRing, a 2D indie action-puzzle game, will drop its demo build on the 13th January 2022! We’ve been hard at work trying to produce the best quality version of the SeaRing demo as possible, so we hope that gets reflected when you can finally submerge yourself in our world! Below you’ll find a breakdown of what’s in store for the demo, and how you could help us as we head to a full release.

[b]Demo Content[/b]
You’ll take the role of a Sea Princess as she wanders far from home in search of her mother’s lost crown.  Start your journey as you wash up on the shore of a local village and enter the Realm of Fire for the very first time. Stroll through the various villages, interacting with its charming civilians and puzzling puzzles, and venture toward the first real boss of the game; pompous Saladino, King of The Bandits! The twist? Defence is the only form of attack, through harnessing the power of the Sea Ring! 

The sadistic Saladino and his seven deadly servants have had their eyes set on you ever since your arrival. Can you tactfully summon the defensive powers of the Sea Ring to put Saladino in his watery grave, or will the constant stream of attacks put a permanent end to your aspirations?    

[b]Upon Full Release[/b]
As a group of passionate game developers, we want to make sure everything is in tip-top shape with every single iteration of SeaRing. That’s why your feedback will be key to the game’s development! We have a few ideas currently in the works that will be shared once finalised. For the time being, we’d love to hear from you, your thoughts on the trailer and game announcement, whilst also inviting you to join our ever-growing community. Don’t hesitate to interact with us via social media, as we’d love to hear your feedback! 

Thanks for reading. Make sure to check out our Linktree, [url=https://linktr.ee/SeaRing]https://linktr.ee/SeaRing[/url], which houses links to our social media accounts, official website, and our newly launched Discord server!

Best Fishes, 
The SeaRing Team
